name: Firefly Fire Pumps Pvt. Ltd.

name: Agni And Technology Consultants

name: Kalsi Industries

name: Star Fire & Security Systems Pvt. Ltd.

name: Kailash Vahn Private Limited

name: Brilliant Engineering Works
reason: Primary business is the manufacturing of firefighting components (nozzles, water monitors, foam systems) rather than complete fire vehicles.

name: Zenith Fire Services India Pvt. Ltd.
reason: Primarily manufactures first-aid fire extinguishing appliances and systems, rather than whole fire trucks or fire vehicles.

name: Bhawani Press Metal & Body Building Pvt Ltd
reason: Primarily a general automotive bodybuilder and distributor of home/solar inverters, trailers, and bus bodies, rather than a specialized primary fire vehicles manufacturer.

name: Delhi Fire Safety Engineers
reason: Primarily operates as a distributor/supplier for large fire fighting vehicles rather than owning the core vehicular brand manufacturing line.

name: Runfire & Security Systems

name: Jaresecure Technologies

name: Advance Fire And Safety India Pvt. Ltd.

name: Antony Garages Private Limited
reason: Operates primarily in automobile body repairs, maintenance, and vehicle servicing for firefighting vehicles rather than brand manufacturing.

name: Vishwas Auto Engineers Private Limited

name: Shakti Fire Services
reason: The company's primary business focuses on supplying, installing, and servicing fire extinguishers, hydrant systems, and alarms rather than manufacturing entire fire vehicles.
